applications.name: Knee osteoarthritis: intra-articular injection (non-surgical, adjacent)

classifications.name: Kellgren-Lawrence
classifications.summary: Radiographic grades 0-4 by osteophytes, joint-space narrowing, sclerosis and deformity; most injection trials enroll grades 2-3

applications.why_biologic: Office-based injections sit beside surgery in every orthobiologics market report: hyaluronic acid viscosupplements (PMA devices), platelet-rich plasma, bone marrow and adipose concentrates, amniotic products and investigational cell and gene therapies. The clinical question is symptom relief and delay of arthroplasty, not bone healing.
applications.autograft_standard: No graft. The comparators are corticosteroid injection, saline (placebo) and exercise therapy; the AAOS 2021 guideline gives hyaluronic acid a 'not recommended' rating at moderate strength and PRP a limited rating.
applications.volume_note: Medicare Part B paid for roughly 1.1 million hyaluronic acid knee injection claims a year in the late 2010s (OIG and MedPAC analyses); no US count of PRP or cell-based knee injections exists because they are cash-pay.

applications.name: Focal chondral and osteochondral defect of the knee: cartilage restoration

classifications.name: ICRS grade
classifications.summary: International Cartilage Repair Society grades 0-4 by depth; grade 3 full-thickness to the calcified layer, grade 4 through subchondral bone

classifications.name: Outerbridge
classifications.summary: Arthroscopic grades I-IV from softening to exposed subchondral bone

applications.why_biologic: Marrow stimulation (microfracture) is the cheap benchmark but produces fibrocartilage; the biologics are cultured autologous chondrocytes on a scaffold, minced or particulated juvenile cartilage allograft, fresh osteochondral allograft, dehydrated cartilage allograft extracellular matrix and acellular scaffolds that are regulated as devices, 361 tissues or BLA biologics.
applications.autograft_standard: Osteochondral autograft transfer (OATS, mosaicplasty) for small lesions and microfracture; limited by donor-site morbidity and lesion size (roughly 2-4 cm2).
applications.volume_note: No reliable US annual count; US registries estimate several hundred thousand knee arthroscopies a year find a chondral lesion, a minority of which are treated with a restoration procedure.

applications.name: Osteochondral lesion of the talus (OLT): cartilage restoration

classifications.name: Berndt and Harty
classifications.summary: Stages I-IV from subchondral compression to a displaced fragment; Hepple's MRI classification adds cyst formation

applications.why_biologic: Bone marrow stimulation is first-line for lesions under about 1 cm2 (roughly 100 mm2); larger, cystic or revision lesions use osteochondral autograft, fresh allograft, particulated juvenile cartilage, or scaffold and cell products, many of them off-label extensions of knee indications.
applications.autograft_standard: Osteochondral autograft from the ipsilateral knee, which carries donor-knee pain in a meaningful minority.

applications.name: Chronic tendinopathy and fasciopathy: injection therapy (lateral epicondylitis, patellar and Achilles tendinopathy, plantar fasciitis, gluteal tendinopathy)
applications.why_biologic: Office injections of platelet-rich plasma, amniotic suspensions, bone marrow or adipose concentrates compete with corticosteroid and eccentric loading; this is where most direct-to-consumer 'regenerative' marketing sits and where the FDA's 361 versus 351 line is drawn.
applications.autograft_standard: No graft; the comparators are corticosteroid injection, saline, dry needling and loading programs.

applications.name: Tendon and ligament repair augmentation (Achilles, ACL, quadriceps and patellar tendon, lateral ankle ligament): scaffolds and patches other than rotator cuff
applications.why_biologic: Collagen, dermal allograft, amniotic and synthetic scaffolds are laid over or into a repair to add strength or induce tissue; the rotator cuff is covered in its own application, this one gathers the rest.
applications.autograft_standard: Autograft tendon (hamstring, patellar, quadriceps) for reconstruction; direct repair without augmentation for most acute tears.
applications.volume_note: ACL reconstructions in the US are commonly estimated at 100,000-200,000 a year in the literature; no count of augmented repairs exists.
